# Pasta Class Florence

> > Hands-on pasta making and Italian cooking classes in Florence, featuring market tours at Sant'Ambrogio and authentic Tuscan culinary experiences.

Pasta Class Florence offers immersive cooking experiences in the heart of Tuscany, teaching traditional Italian pasta techniques and regional recipes. The school combines market tours, hands-on instruction, and authentic Italian ingredients to create memorable culinary experiences in Florence and pop-up locations across Europe.

- Pasta making

## Cooking Classes & Experiences

- [Cooking Class Florence | Pasta & Italian Cooking Experiences](https://pastaclassflorence.com/cooking-classes-florence): Main cooking class page: pasta making, Tuscan wine, Sant'Ambrogio Market
- [Market Tour & Pasta Cooking Class in Florence | Sant'Ambrogio](https://pastaclassflorence.com/market-tour-pasta-cooking-class): Sant'Ambrogio Market tour with hands-on pasta class, meal, and wine
- [Cooking Classes in Europe – Discover 3 Unique Culinary Experiences](https://pastaclassflorence.com/pasta-class-europe): Pop-up cooking classes across Europe in Dublin, Amsterdam, and Florence
- [Cooking classes in Florence: how to choose](https://pastaclassflorence.com/cooking-classes-in-florence-3-questions-to-ask-yourself): Guide to selecting the right cooking class in Florence for your needs

## Traditional Pasta Recipes

- [Pumpkin Tortelli: learn how to make the recipe like a pro](https://pastaclassflorence.com/pumpkin-tortelli): Traditional Po Valley pumpkin tortelli recipe from Mantua and Parma regions
- [Ravioli con ricotta e spinaci: perfect spring pasta recipe](https://pastaclassflorence.com/ravioli-ricotta-spinach): Spring ravioli recipe with ricotta, spinach, and brown butter sauce
- [Seafood Gnocchi: a summer seafood dream begins here](https://pastaclassflorence.com/seafood-gnocchi): Summer seafood gnocchi recipe with Yukon Gold potatoes and Calabrian chili
- [Homemade garganelli pasta what is it](https://pastaclassflorence.com/what-is-garganelli-pasta): Guide to garganelli pasta history from Ferrara and Bentivoglio court

## Italian Cooking Guides

- [Five Essential Italian Herbs and How to Cook with Them](https://pastaclassflorence.com/five-essential-italian-herbs-how-to-cook-them): Guide to using sage, rosemary, thyme, oregano, basil in Italian cooking
- [Pesto Sauce](https://pastaclassflorence.com/pesto-sauce): Easy 30-minute Genoese pesto sauce recipe with Parmigiano Reggiano
- [How can you cook pasta without boiling it?](https://pastaclassflorence.com/cooking-pasta-with-heath-off): Passive cooking method for energy-saving pasta preparation technique

## Florence Travel & Culture
